name: hpresence
description: Records which app is frontmost, whether you're idle and, only in browsers you choose, each site's domain (never its path or title), as daily totals per Mac; no screenshots, audio or keystrokes.

config.label: track websites in these browsers
config.help: Off unless you list browsers here, one per line: Google Chrome, Brave Browser, Microsoft Edge, Arc, Chromium, Safari. macOS asks once per browser to let hpresence control it (an Automation prompt); decline and that browser counts as an app only. Only the domain of http(s) pages is kept. Chrome, Brave, Edge, Arc and Chromium: only windows that report themselves as normal are read, so incognito and private windows are skipped. Safari can't report private windows, so they would be recorded too: add Safari only if you don't browse privately in it. Firefox can't share its tab and always counts as an app only.

config.label: never record these sites
config.help: One per line, e.g. example.com (covers its subdomains too). Stronger than the vault: an excluded site is never written anywhere; the time still counts toward the browser app.
